caption: The drawing centers on a decorative vase with an undulating, scalloped rim, rendered primarily in shades of gray with subtle blue tones. The vase rests on an ornate base featuring curving, sculpted details, also in a similar gray palette. Around the neck and midsection of the vase, there is a garland of white and yellow flowers with green leaves interspersed, adding color contrast. Four smaller outlined sketches frame the main vase illustration: in the upper left is a partial side-view outline of the vase’s neck and rim; in the upper right, a back-view silhouette of the whole vase; in the lower left, a small circular cartouche containing the characters “G.F. 349”; and in the lower right, a foliate or shell-shaped decorative motif. The artist’s signature, “Josephine Lindsley,” is at the lower right corner. The drawing is rendered on a cream or off-white background.
title: White Porcelain Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
